name: ainet_path_probe_fan_init_from_segment
description: AINetPathProbeFan::InitFromSegment initializes segment delta, clamped travel, perpendicular XZ basis, +/-45 probe directions, and path width.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; Binary Ninja still exposes x87 clamp scaffolding, so byte matching should be handled with the coherent AINet source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x403620 validates the thiscall ABI with two by-value zVec3 stack arguments and pathWidth, delta = to - from, clampedTravel = max(XZLength - pathWidth, pathWidth * 0.5), in-place zMath::Vec3NormalizeXZ over the delta field, zMath::Vec3PerpXZ into offset 0x10, zMath::Vec3RotateY into offsets 0x1c and 0x28 with +45.0 and -45.0, and pathWidth stored at offset 0x34.

The native smoke verifies normalized delta, preserved delta.y, clampedTravel on both long and short segments, perpendicular generation, both rotated probe directions using the existing zMath::Vec3RotateY behavior, and pathWidth storage.
